# LuaSPortSerial

`LuaSPortSerial` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `serial:empty()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`empty()`](empty.md) | Return true if the read buffer is empty. | 1.1.0 |
| [`size()`](size.md) | Return the read buffer size. | 1.1.0 |
| [`read()`](read.md) | Return the read buffer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`write()`](write.md) | Write a buffer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`flush()`](flush.md) | Flush a buffer. | 1.1.0 |
